svg.font-family: Lato, 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, 'Liberation Sans', sans-serif

text.font-family: 'Playfair Display', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', 'Liberation Serif', serif
text.tspan: Monthly sea ice extent in the Antarctic, decadal average
Each point represents the monthly average sea ice extent, averaged across all years within the decade. The
current decade is highlighted in red, with the current year shown in black for comparison.

tspan.tspan: National Snow and Ice Data Center - Sea Ice Index (2026)
The horizontal axis shows months from January (1) to December (12). All years have data for all 12 months, except 1987 and 1988 (each

text.tspan: missing one month) and the current year.
